## B. Gain vs distance to the reference: nearest P vs the GOP's I frame (per-block ORACLE ceilings, B and P frames, each reference on its own)

## C. TemporalDetail CPU model: true vs inferred frame types, reference window (max age), GOP variants, camera model

Base = the least-strict set (only motion uncertainty + base match + coherence + the output guard; evidence, stronger, high-band, focus, correlation, harm open; grain budget off). `true` = admission from the TRUE coded frame types (I always becomes the reference, B never) - live VP over HDMI has no frame types. `ma` = max reference age in seconds (default 2). ref I/P/B = share of transferring blocks on B frames whose detail comes from an I / P / B source frame; dist = mean frames to that source. infer = frame-type inference from the model's own per-frame detail energy (anchor accuracy, I recall / precision).
